card.name: The word disorders after psychiatric
card.fires_on: The word "disorders" right after "psychiatric" in antidepressant suicide-risk warnings, in the phrase "depression and certain other psychiatric disorders".

modes.label: Psychiatric disorders in suicide warning
modes.description: "disorders" follows "psychiatric" in the antidepressant suicidality warning text.
modes.example: Suicide is a known risk of depression and certain other psychiatric<< disorders>>, and these disorders themselves are the strongest

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and unrelated, though disability-related words are suppressed, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "disorders" in the antidepressant warning about suicide risk in depression and other psychiatric disorders.
